name: Testing harness & CI matrix
description:
Set up the testing harness per §12: fixture layout for recorded shop HTML/headers, golden-envelope tests for every --json success/error shape, a test asserting --describe matches Stricli's own parameter definitions (parity test), and a CI matrix across macOS + Linux + Windows on supported Node majors.

This is Phase-0 spine work, not a later chore — the hardest-to-test component (proxy + injection) is on the MVP critical path.
